intermediateResults.detail: Sandbox prevented esbuild child spawn (EPERM); no tests executed. Permissioned isolated rerun passed.

Existing campaign-current-value fixture lacked getGA4RevenuePublication added in the prior deployed change. Added the mock and a receipt assertion; all 13 tests pass in selector-final. No runtime guard or expectation relaxed.

First shell attempt had argument quoting error; sandbox then blocked child spawn. Permissioned start on default port exited; explicit 127.0.0.1:55444 started successfully but its inherited pipe timed out after status 0. PostgreSQL log and tests verified readiness. Cleanup confirms the isolated cluster is stopped.

isolation: Credential-stripped test runners, localhost-only network preload, disposable local PostgreSQL schemas, intercepted synthetic browser responses; no production/provider/Ptomo access or writes.
limitations: No measured hosted latency or deployed acceptance for this change. Busy workers and browser polling can still delay visibility; no immediate-update guarantee.
Multi-GA4 connections, absent/stale/wrong-scope/native inputs and invalid financial inputs retain full refresh. Lookup exceptions fail the attempt.

Orchestration uses mocked provider/storage/downstream boundaries and the real saved-total selector/writer; separate PostgreSQL and browser tests prove their bounded contracts, not live-provider end-to-end behavior.
Derived tables are guarded sequentially, not one atomic transaction spanning all tables.
Broader provider lifecycle, Shopify acceptance and natural scheduler/deployed tests remain open. Previously documented unrelated KPI fixture and whole-suite failures are not recertified or waived.
